images.title: Overview
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / ads-marketing. Create ONE final high-resolution landscape PNG promotional infographic for the JetBrains Marketplace gallery of the Kotlin IntelliJ plugin "Volan Schema". Canvas 1600 x 1000 pixels (or 1536 x 1024 if fixed sizes); MUST at least 1200 px wide and 760 px tall. Not a collage of several banners.
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE: the supplied image is the EXISTING brand logo to reproduce faithfully as a supporting insert, NOT a layout to edit. Keep the same black diagonal shuttlecock with three feathers, one band and rounded base, clear white gaps, pointing toward upper right. Preserve the recognizable exact silhouette; no new logo, no badminton racket.

Art direction for a coordinated set: premium Swiss editorial developer-tool design. Warm ivory #F5F3ED, ink #17191D, soft gray rules, sparing acidic lime #D7FF62. Flat precise typography, no perspective, no 3D, no glossy stock illustrations. Beautiful generous margins, crisp readable monospaced code, coherent baseline grid. 80 px safety margins. Large concise copy, readable at gallery thumbnail size.

This is the first/overview image. Left 42%: existing shuttlecock mark large in black, placed above restrained label "VOLAN SCHEMA"; oversized two-line headline "Your schema." / "In focus."; supporting line "Schema support for IntelliJ IDEA"; small secondary text "For the Volan ORM · Kotlin + Java". Right 58%: a polished dark, straight-on cropped editor illustration with slim tab bar and tiny exact logo by the tab "schema.volan". Large syntax-highlighted code, exact text:
model User {
  id    Int      @id
  email String   @unique
  posts Post[]
}
Clearly a stylized editor preview, not a fake full IDE screenshot. Code language keywords amber, type names pale blue, attributes purple, punctuation gray, field names ivory.

Across bottom, four neatly aligned line icons with labels VERBATIM: "Smart completion", "Inline diagnostics", "Navigation", "Formatting". Use a spark/cursor, alert circle, branching arrow, aligned lines respectively. Small footer: "IntelliJ IDEA plugin" and unobtrusive "Illustrated editor preview". No "AI", no database runner, no marketplace approval or stars, no unsupported feature. Render all letters and all code exactly. Modern, confident, spacious, no generic oversized rounded card grid.

images.title: Smart completion
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE final landscape marketplace infographic for "Volan Schema", at 1600 x 1000 pixels, or 1536 x 1024; MUST at least 1200 x 760. Supplied image is only the existing shuttlecock logo reference: preserve its diagonal three feathers, band and rounded base silhouette; reproduce in ivory on dark. Do not redesign logo.

Coordinated brand style: Swiss editorial developer tool, charcoal #17191D background, ivory #F5F3ED type, pale blue / lavender syntax, acidic lime #D7FF62 used sparingly for active selection and a thin connector. 80 px margins, perfectly crisp 2D, premium typography, no neon glow, no perspective, no 3D, no stock photo.

Small top-left logo + "VOLAN SCHEMA". Main large headline VERBATIM: "Completion that knows" / "your schema." Smaller line: "Types, attributes and relations — in context."
Dominant lower-right section is a dark editor illustration, straight-on, with "schema.volan" tab and syntax-highlighted real Volan code, exactly:
model User {
  id    Uuid   @id
  posts Post[]
}

model Post {
  id       Int  @id
  authorId Uuid
  author   User @rel
}
Caret directly after @rel. A completion popup near that line has one selected entry "relation" with tiny matching shuttlecock file icon, and subtle type hint "User". Below editor a compact lime-accent inset shows the exact inserted result:
@relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])
Ensure all code parentheses, square brackets, commas and type names are correct; no invented Prisma/SQL syntax.

Left-side three short callouts with small outline icons and explanatory one-liners:
"Compatible foreign keys" / "Uuid matches Uuid"
"Ordered composite keys" / "Preserves declared key order"
"Context-aware attributes" / "No duplicate suggestions"
Include a tiny key-to-key diagram: "User.id : Uuid" connected to "Post.authorId : Uuid". Do not claim automatic creation of fields, code generation, migrations or AI. Small footer "Ctrl+Space" and "Illustrated editor preview". Balanced room for typography and code, no crowding.

images.title: Diagnostics
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / ads-marketing. ONE final landscape PNG marketplace infographic for the IntelliJ plugin "Volan Schema"; 1600 x 1000 pixels or 1536 x 1024; at least 1200 x 760. Supplied image is an existing logo reference, preserve the diagonal black shuttlecock silhouette with three feathers, band, round base and white separations, not its white-square photograph backdrop.

Same coordinated premium editorial style: warm ivory #F5F3ED, deep charcoal #17191D, subtle gray separators, very restrained coral/red for a real diagnostic. 80 px safety margin; typography crisp and elegant, large headline, flat straight-on editor graphic; no fake screenshots, no neon, no perspective, no cute characters.

Small upper logo lockup "VOLAN SCHEMA". Main headline EXACT "Catch mistakes." / "Keep your flow." Subheadline EXACT "Syntax and semantic checks, right in the editor."
Central/right dark editor illustration with tab "schema.volan", line numbers, large monospaced highlighted code:
model User {
  id   Int @id
  name Strng
}
Only the typo "Strng" receives a red wavy underline and a small error marker in gutter. A readable floating diagnostic panel points to it, with error-circle icon, EXACT strings "[E0201] Unknown type 'Strng'" and "Did you mean String?". Do NOT show an Apply/Fix button, because the plugin displays guidance rather than an implemented quick-fix button.

A clear slim supporting section with three outline icons and EXACT headings "Syntax", "Types", "Relations". Bottom copy EXACT "Inline errors · Stable error codes · Useful explanations". A slim comparison before/after type annotation "Strng → String" may be shown below tooltip as explanatory graphic, not as an automatic editor action. Small footer "Illustrated editor preview". Keep it spacious and persuasive, tightly designed code punctuation correct. No artificial performance statistics, no unsupported AI claims, no star rating, no approval seal.

images.title: Formatting and navigation
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE final landscape high-resolution PNG promotional gallery image for "Volan Schema" IntelliJ plugin at 1600 x 1000 pixels or 1536 x 1024; at least 1200 x 760. Supplied reference is the existing diagonal shuttlecock mark: faithfully preserve three feathers, band and round base. Insert it as branding and little file icons, black on light and ivory on dark. Do not redesign it.

Coordinated visual system: premium Swiss editorial, warm ivory #F5F3ED canvas, ink #17191D, pale blue/lavender code colors, restrained lime #D7FF62 arrow. Flat 2D, clean typography, generous 80 px outer margins, exceptionally readable code. Main title EXACT "Clean schemas." / "Clear structure." Small logo + "VOLAN SCHEMA" above, subline "Format, navigate and understand your schema."

Two wide editor panels aligned horizontally, with same slim tab "schema.volan" and tiny logo. Label above left "BEFORE", above right "AFTER", fine horizontal arrow between. Left panel darker charcoal showing unaligned exact code:
model User {
id Int @id
email String @unique
name String?
posts Post[]
}
Right panel charcoal showing precisely aligned code (spaces are significant):
model User {
  id    Int      @id
  email String   @unique
  name  String?
  posts Post[]
}
Right aligned columns must stay monospaced and aligned. Keep all complete braces and line numbers, no truncated text. A small readable chip near arrow "Ctrl+Alt+L". No claims of partial-selection formatting or automatic formatting while typing.

Under comparison, elegant three-item row, each with outline icon:
"Format" with shortcut "Ctrl+Alt+L"
"Navigate" with shortcut "Ctrl+B"
"Documentation" with shortcut "Ctrl+Q"
Small supporting line "Light and dark file icons" next to two small exact shuttlecock icons, one on an ivory swatch and one on charcoal. Tiny footer "Windows / Linux shortcuts" and "Illustrated editor previews". No unrelated features, no faux JetBrains endorsement, no excessive decorative UI. Precise and polished.
